knowledge_points.content: The tandem solar cell utilizes P3HT:PC70BM as the photoactive layer for the top cell and PSBTBT:PC70BM for the bottom cell.
knowledge_points.evidence: P3HT:PC70BM and PSBTBT:PC70BM were the photoactive layers for the top and bottom cells, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: The interconnecting layer (ICL) in the tandem device consists of a stacked transparent n-type metal semiconductor (ZnO) and a conductive hole transport layer (PEDOT:PSS) neutralized with NaOH.
knowledge_points.evidence: The two photoactive layers were connected by a stacked transparent n-type metal semiconductor (ZnO) and a conductive hole transport layer (PEDOT:PSS)... The PEDOT:PSS was neutralized by using NaOH solution to prevent the acidity of the PEDOT from penetrating into the underlying ZnO thin film.

knowledge_points.content: The optimized organic tandem solar cell achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 6.38%, an open-circuit voltage (Voc) of 1.45 V, a short-circuit current density (Jsc) of 6.93 mA/cm², and a fill factor (FF) of 63.71%.
knowledge_points.evidence: Our constructed tandem organic solar cell exhibited a Jsc of 6.93 mA cm-2, Voc of 1.45 V, FF of 63.36%, and PCE of 6.38%. (Table 1 lists FF as 63.71%)

knowledge_points.content: The open-circuit voltage (Voc) of the series-connected tandem cell (1.45 V) is approximately 95.40% of the sum of the individual top (0.88 V) and bottom (0.64 V) cell voltages.
knowledge_points.evidence: As a result, the Voc of the prepared tandem solar cell was 1.45 V; reaching approximately 95.40% of the summation of the top and bottom Voc values (1.52 V).

knowledge_points.content: In series-connected tandem organic solar cells, the interconnecting layer facilitates the recombination of electrons from the top cell with holes from the bottom cell.
knowledge_points.evidence: The electrons from the top cell combined with the holes from the bottom cell at the ZnO/PEDOT:PSS interconnecting layer.

knowledge_points.content: The ZnO interconnecting layer is processed from a precursor solution containing zinc acetate dehydrate and monoethanolamine in 2-methoxyethanol, followed by annealing at 150 °C for 5 minutes.
knowledge_points.evidence: The interconnecting layer was fabricated through the deposition of an amorphous layer of ZnO, which consisted of zinc acetate dehydrate (0.5 M) in monoethanolamine (0.5 M) and 2-methoxyethanol. The ZnO solution was spun at 4000 rpm for 25 s and annealed at 150 °C for 5 min under ambient air.

knowledge_points.content: Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) analysis revealed that the RMS roughness of the top cell (P3HT:PC70BM) was 9.77 nm, while the bottom cell (PSBTBT:PC70BM) showed a much lower RMS roughness of 1.20 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: However, the root mean square (RMS) value for the top cell was high at approximately 9.77 nm whereas the bottom cell had a RMS value of only 1.20 nm.

knowledge_points.content: X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns indicate that the P3HT:PC70BM layer possesses a well-ordered structure with (100) and (200) peaks, whereas the PEDOT:PSS layer is amorphous.
knowledge_points.evidence: From these patterns, it was determined that PEDOT:PSS was amorphous, whereas P3HT:PC70BM exhibited well-ordered P3HT with (100) and (200) peaks, which correspond to the P3HT chain.

knowledge_points.content: The External Quantum Efficiency (EQE) of the P3HT:PC70BM top cell reaches a maximum of 48% at 456 nm, while the PSBTBT:PC70BM bottom cell reaches a maximum of 33% at 610 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: The P3HT:PC70BM based top cell exhibited... the highest EQE value at 456 nm, which corresponded to 48% EQE. The bottom cell... highest EQE value was 33% at 610 nm.

knowledge_points.content: The tandem solar cell demonstrated high stability with only a 2.19% decrease in power conversion efficiency (from 6.38% to 6.24%) after 720 hours of exposure to AM1.5G conditions.
knowledge_points.evidence: Overall, even after 720 h exposure, our fabricated tandem solar cell exhibited high stability and the efficiency only decreased by approximately 2.19%, to 6.24%.

knowledge_points.content: The use of a solution-processed ZnO layer with a deep HOMO level contributes to the environmental stability of the tandem device by preventing the generation of defects.
knowledge_points.evidence: We attributed this excellent stability to the presence of the environmentally stable solution-processed ZnO layer with a deep HOMO level, which avoided generating any defects in the device.

knowledge_points.content: To achieve balanced photogenerated currents in series-connected tandem cells, a thin absorption layer with a large band-gap material is typically used for the top cell and a thick layer with a narrow band-gap material for the bottom cell.
knowledge_points.evidence: It is generally accepted that for series-connected tandem organic solar cells, precise optimization of the absorption window and the photogenerated currents... can be realized by initially using a thin absorption layer with a large band-gap material and then a thick absorption layer with a narrow band-gap material.
